basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast and avid gamer from Portland, Oregon. My interests lie in emerging technologies and online gaming communities. I work as a software developer by day and dive into the world of Brawl Stars and Krunker.IO by night. I'm usually online in the evenings, around 7 PM to midnight PST. I'm single and enjoy discussing tech stocks and debunking conspiracy theories in my free time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the software development industry for the past 5 years. My passion for technology and gaming led me to self-teach various programming languages and explore different gaming strategies. I frequently engage in online forums to keep up with the latest trends and share insights.
